description: This file defines the interface 'EMICalculator' in a loan management system, specifying methods for generating interest schedules, applying disbursements, interest rate changes, repayments, and computing various loan-related financial details. It serves as a contract for implementing classes to perform EMI calculations and manage loan interest schedules.

classes.name: EMICalculator
classes.description: Interface defining methods for calculating and managing loan EMI and interest schedules.

methods.name: generatePeriodInterestScheduleModel
methods.description: Creates an interest schedule model based on provided schedule periods and loan details.

methods.name: generateInstallmentInterestScheduleModel
methods.description: Creates an interest schedule model based on existing loan installments.

methods.name: findRepaymentPeriod
methods.description: Finds a repayment period based on a specific due date.

methods.name: addDisbursement
methods.description: Applies a disbursement to the interest schedule, updating EMI amounts from the disbursement date.

methods.name: addCapitalizedIncome
methods.description: Applies capitalized income transaction to the interest schedule, recalculating EMIs.

methods.name: changeInterestRate
methods.description: Updates interest rate on the schedule and recalculates EMIs from the change date.

methods.name: addRepaymentPeriods
methods.description: Adds new repayment periods to the interest schedule.

methods.name: addBalanceCorrection
methods.description: Adjusts the outstanding balance due to late payments or corrections.

methods.name: payInterest
methods.description: Records interest payment on the schedule.

methods.name: payPrincipal
methods.description: Records principal repayment on the schedule.

methods.name: creditPrincipal
methods.description: Credits principal, increasing outstanding balance, creating virtual EMI for the period.

methods.name: creditInterest
methods.description: Credits interest, adding extra interest, creating virtual EMI for the period.

methods.name: getDueAmounts
methods.description: Returns maximum due principal and interest for a given day.

methods.name: getPeriodInterestTillDate
methods.description: Calculates total interest accrued till a specified date.

methods.name: getOutstandingLoanBalanceOfPeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the outstanding loan balance for a specific date.

methods.name: getOutstandingAmountsTillDate
methods.description: Gets details of outstanding amounts up to a given date.

methods.name: calculateRateFactorForRepaymentPeriod
methods.description: Calculates the rate factor for a repayment period.

methods.name: getSumOfDueInterestsOnDate
methods.description: Sums the due interests on a specified date.

methods.name: applyInterestPause
methods.description: Pauses interest accrual over a date range, charges still accrue during chargeback.
